This miscellaneous appeal having been heard and reserv  orders, coming on for pronouncement this day, Justice Achal K  Paliwal pronounced the following:

ORDER This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 18.08.2022 passed by MACT, Mandleshwar (WN) in Claim Case No.09/2021 seeking enhancement of compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the find ings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
for the permanent disability suffered by the appellant/claimant, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.1,27,300/- along with interest.

The breakup of the compensation amount is as under:
Permanent disability -Rs.91300/- (i.e.6500x12x9/100x13) Medical expenses -Rs.5000/-
 Transportation -Rs.2000/-
 Special diet -Rs.2000/-
 Attendant -Rs.2000/-
Gajrajsingh Tomar vs Sabid on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67735010/
2  Pain & suffering -Rs.25000/-
 -----------------
 TOTAL Rs.1,27,300/-
3.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.

In the accident, the appellant/claimant suffered 9% permanent disability, however, the Tribunal did not award any compensation under the head of future prospects in the light of the judgment in the case of National Insurance Co. Ltd. Vs. Pranay Sethi reported in (2017) 16 SCC 680.

entities.text: National Insurance Co. Ltd. Vs. Pranay Sethi reported in (2017) 16 SCC 680
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The compensation awarded under other conventional heads is also on the lower side, hence prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the case.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which does not call for any interference by this Court.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant and the evidence that came on record, in the considered opinion of this Court, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side which deserves to be and is hereby enhanced as under:
 Permanent disability -Rs.1,14,075/-
 (i.e.Rs.6500+25%
 FPx12x9/100x13)
 Other conventional heads i.e  Loss of wages, pain & suffering,
 Medical expenses/ attendant etc. -Rs.64500/-
 ----------------
 TOTAL Rs.1,78,575/-
Gajrajsingh Tomar vs Sabid on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67735010/
3 6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.1,78,575/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.1,27,300/-.
Accordingly, the appellant is entitled to an additional sum of Rs.51,275/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
7. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.51,275/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

8. The appellant has valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.40,000/- and paid the Court fee accordingly, however, for the remaining amount of Rs.11,275/- the Court fee shall be paid by the appellant within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
9.
In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated herein above.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE hk/
